landingSites.name: Apollo 11
landingSites.notes: LM (Eagle) position from LRO images, DE421 mean-Earth/polar-axis (planetocentric) frame; identical to the NSSDC landing-site table value. Touchdown 20:17:40 UT.

landingSites.name: Apollo 12
landingSites.notes: LM (Intrepid) position; landed ~180 m from Surveyor 3. Touchdown 06:54:35 UT.

landingSites.name: Apollo 14
landingSites.region: 弗拉·毛罗高地（Fra Mauro highlands）
landingSites.notes: LM (Antares) position; lunar highlands near Fra Mauro. Touchdown 09:18:11 UT.

landingSites.name: Apollo 15
landingSites.region: 雨海·哈德利-亚平宁（Hadley–Apennine, Mare Imbrium）
landingSites.notes: LM (Falcon) position; foot of the Apennine range. Touchdown 22:16:29 UT.

landingSites.name: Apollo 16
landingSites.notes: LM (Orion) position on LM page (IAU mean-Earth/polar-axis). NSSDC coordinate table lists -8.9734, 15.5011 (differ <0.002 deg). Touchdown 02:23:35 UT on 21 April.

landingSites.name: Apollo 17
landingSites.region: 澄海东南缘·陶拉斯-利特罗（Taurus–Littrow）
landingSites.notes: LM (Challenger) position; Taurus-Littrow valley, SE rim of Mare Serenitatis. Touchdown 19:54:57 UT.

landingSites.name: Chang'e 3
landingSites.notes: LROC lander solution 44.1214 N, 340.4884 E (published 0-360 E); NSSDC (archived) gives 44.1214 N, 19.5117 W. Landing 13:11 UTC.

landingSites.name: Chang'e 4
landingSites.region: 冯·卡门撞击坑（Von Kármán crater），南极-艾特肯盆地
landingSites.notes: LROC refined lander position +/-13 m (95% CI); earlier LROC estimate 45.457 S, 177.589 E +/-20 m (images/1087); NSSDC (archived) 45.4561 S, 177.5885 E. Landing 02:26 UT.

landingSites.name: Chang'e 5
landingSites.mission: 中国首次月球采样返回
landingSites.notes: LROC lander position, published 43.0576 N, 308.0839 E (=51.9161 W); NSSDC (archived) 43.058 N, 51.916 W. Touchdown 15:11 UTC (LROC) / ~15:13 UT (NSSDC).

landingSites.name: Chang'e 6
landingSites.mission: 人类首次月背采样返回
landingSites.region: 阿波罗盆地南缘（southern Apollo basin），南极-艾特肯盆地
landingSites.notes: LROC lander position on rim of an eroded ~50 m crater, published 41.6385 S, 206.0148 E (=153.9852 W), horizontal accuracy +/-30 m. Landing date 1 June 2024 (UTC) per LROC; exact UTC time not verified here.

landingSites.name: Luna 9
landingSites.region: 风暴洋（Oceanus Procellarum），赖纳坑与马利乌斯坑以西
landingSites.notes: NSSDC states the site is 'approximately' 7.08 N, 64.37 W - an estimate, no LROC-confirmed position found. Touchdown 18:45:30 UT. Live NSSDC page returns ORA-01403; archived copy read.

landingSites.name: Luna 16
landingSites.mission: 首次无人月球采样返回
landingSites.notes: Lander position, ~100 km west of Webb crater; touchdown 05:18 UT. Live NSSDC page returns ORA-01403; archived copy read.

landingSites.name: Luna 17 (Lunokhod 1)
landingSites.notes: Lander position; same page gives Lunokhod 1 at 38.3150 N, 35.0081 W (LROC 2010 table: 38.316, 324.996 E). Touchdown 03:46:50 UT. Live NSSDC page returns ORA-01403; archived copy read.

landingSites.name: Luna 21 (Lunokhod 2)
landingSites.region: 勒莫尼耶环形山（Le Monnier crater），澄海东缘
landingSites.notes: Lander position in Le Monnier crater; same page gives Lunokhod 2 at 25.8323 N, 30.9222 E. Landing 23:35 UT. Live NSSDC page returns ORA-01403; archived copy read.

landingSites.name: Surveyor 1
landingSites.region: 风暴洋西南部（southwest Oceanus Procellarum）
landingSites.notes: Published as 2.4745 S, 316.6602 E; normalized here to -180..180. Flat area inside a 100 km crater north of Flamsteed. Touchdown 06:17:36 UT.

landingSites.name: Surveyor 3
landingSites.region: 风暴洋东南部（southeast Oceanus Procellarum），哥白尼坑以南约370 km
landingSites.notes: Published as 3.0162 S, 336.582 E; normalized to -23.418 (=336.582 E). Initial touchdown 00:04:17 UT, final 00:04:53 UT. Visited by Apollo 12.

landingSites.name: Surveyor 7
landingSites.region: 月球高地，第谷坑以北（lunar highlands north of Tycho）
landingSites.notes: Published as 40.9812 S, 11.5127 W. On an ejecta blanket ~47 km (29 mi) north of the Tycho rim. Touchdown 01:05:36.3 UT.

phaseDefinitions.statement: USNO: New Moon, First Quarter, Full Moon and Last Quarter 'are defined to occur when the excess of the apparent ecliptic (celestial) longitude of the Moon over that of the Sun is 0, 90, 180, and 270 degrees, respectively' (i.e. Sun-Moon-Earth elongation); the waxing crescent/gibbous phases lie between 0-90/90-180 deg with the illuminated fraction increasing, and the waning gibbous/crescent phases between 180-270/270-360 deg with it decreasing. NASA (science.nasa.gov/moon/moon-phases) lists the same eight phases in that order and defines them by how much of the Sun-lit half faces Earth. Appearance is not a function of one light angle: NASA SVS 'Moon Phase and Libration' (https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/5187/) renders the geocentric phase, libration, axis position angle and apparent diameter only from the JPL DE421 ephemeris plus the LOLA DEM and LROC mosaic, and the sub-Earth point, axis roll and distance all vary with time, so an ephemeris is required.

unverified: Chinese official sources for Chang'e coordinates could not be verified: cnsa.gov.cn timed out (no connection from this host), clpds.bao.ac.cn returned HTTP 502, www.clep.org.cn loaded but no landing-coordinate page was located, and moon.bao.ac.cn is a JavaScript SPA with no readable coordinate page. All four Chang'e coordinates therefore come from NASA/GSFC/ASU LROC (and, for CE-3/4/5, archived NASA NSSDC pages).

NSSDC live master-catalog pages for Luna 9/16/17/21 and Chang'e 3/4/5/6 (ids 1966-006A, 1970-072A, 1970-095A, 1973-001A, 2013-070A, 2018-103A, 2020-087A, 2024-083A) return Oracle error ORA-01403 as of 2026-10-12; archived Wayback snapshots were read instead (URLs recorded in sourceUrl/sourcesRead).
Luna 9: NSSDC publishes the site only as 'approximately 7.08 N, 64.37 W'; no authoritative precise (LROC-confirmed) position found, so this is an approximate value.
USNO live page https://aa.usno.navy.mil/faq/moon_phases is unreachable from this host (TLS handshake failure / HTTP 502); the 2023-09-23 Wayback snapshot was read instead.
Apollo 16: NSSDC's LM page (-8.9730, 15.5002) and NSSDC's landing-site table (-8.9734, 15.5011) differ by <0.002 deg; both are NASA values, no third source was used to arbitrate.

Chang'e 6 exact UTC touchdown time not verified (only the date 2024-06-01 from LROC); Chang'e 3/5/6 and Surveyor 1/3 longitudes were published in 0-360 deg E form and are normalized here to -180..180 (published forms kept in notes).

No NASA/NOAA/USNO source was found that states the 'single scene-light angle' limitation in those words; it is stated here as the documented consequence of NASA SVS computing phase/libration/orientation from an ephemeris (DE421) rather than from one illumination angle.
